parsed.explanation: Lemma (ii) is the write-up's only route to the universal lower bound, and its entire proof is the quoted paragraph (the file lemmas/refinement.md is not reproduced). The counting sub-claim is indeed false: columns d,...,2^j d hold 2^{j+1}-1 strips, so 'two identical copies plus one' would be 2^{j+2}-1 strips while the new column 2^{j+1}d has only 2^{j+1}; the correct identity is that the new column equals all preceding columns plus one strip. Moreover no argument covers Xiang's cuts at non-multiples of d, so the inductive dichotomy is never justified. Nothing elsewhere supplies Delta >= 1/(2^{n+1}-1); a genuine argument (minimal signed sum / tree, or parity induction) must be supplied.
